name: Contract views keep a qualified namespace and derived hash

input.source_text: contract C { fun n() -> Symbol } class B for C { public impl fun n() -> Symbol { :base } } class A extends B { public override impl fun n() -> Symbol { super() } } module M { public fun run() -> Object { let a = A.new(); [(a as C)..n(), a.n(), (a as C) == (a as C), C.hash() == C.hash()] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Contract view dispatch has no native boundary.
